name: The Daughters of the Sun
source:
Phaedra, wife of Theseus, king of Athens, has burnt for years of a dark flame for her
step-son, Hippolytus. After confessing her love to him and being rejected, she takes a poison to lead her to her death. In her final instants, she remembers her mother and sister's tragic fates, also unfortunate in love for the sole crime of being Daughters of the Sun.

[from [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/daughters-of-the-sun]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雅典国王忒修斯的妻子菲德拉为她燃烧了多年的黑暗火焰
继子，希波吕托斯。向他表白遭到拒绝后，她服毒自杀。在生命的最后一刻，她想起了母亲和妹妹的悲惨命运，也因为成为太阳之女的唯一罪孽而不幸陷入爱情。

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/daughters-of-the-sun]itch.io[/url]]
